description: Widget-only helper: mint a one-time upload session so the file upload form can send the selected file to QRCodeKIT without exposing credentials. Not intended for direct use; prefer 'Upload a File → Get a Link & QR'.

filename.description: Original filename of the selected file.
filename.title: Filename

mime_type.description: MIME type reported by the browser for the selected file.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

size_bytes.description: Size of the selected file in bytes. Must be at most 50 MB.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

typology.description: Use 'file' for an arbitrary file or 'pdf' for a PDF.
typology.title: Typology

name: create_file_upload_session

outputSchema.description: One-time upload session minted by the backend for the Claude upload widget.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the session expires.
expires_at.title: Expires At

field_name.description: Multipart field name for the uploaded file.
field_name.title: Field Name

max_bytes.description: Maximum accepted upload size in bytes.
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

method.description: HTTP method the widget must use for the upload.
method.title: Method

upload_url.description: Single-use URL the widget posts the file to (multipart form data).
upload_url.title: Upload Url

outputSchema.title: FileUploadSession

title: Create File Upload Session
